# Fixture: deliberately violates the direction_text rule.
extends RefCounted

const FACING_DEFAULT := "down"

func anim_for(facing: String) -> String:
	if facing == "left":
		return "walk_left"
	# A compass spelling is the same mistake in a different vocabulary.
	if facing == "north":
		return "walk_up"
	return "idle_down"

func not_a_violation() -> String:
	# "walk_left" and "walk_down" above are compound names, not bare directions, and this
	# comment mentions left and up without either being a string literal.
	return "portrait_left_eye"
